about_the_game:
Hike, jump, and climb to traverse the treacherous terrain of the island to help villagers deliver parcels and complete their tasks and requests.

Amid crumbling traditions, a vanished scientist, and a mystery yet to be unfolded, the island calls with a fading serenade to a quieter life.

Key Features

  • Deliver packages, letters, tools, and various things around the island. Manage your inventory and be careful not to damage anything!

  • Get to know the island's inhabitants. They might be reserved in the presence of strangers, but help them enough, and they might open up and help you.

  • Move around the island by running around, jumping and balancing over rivers and creeks, and climbing various obstacles. Be careful with the things you carry with you, they might make it hard to move!

  • This is the demo version. While the final game will be semi-open-ended, this demo will have a dedicated end after around an hour!
